specialty_focus: Orion Pharma is a global Finnish pharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets human and veterinary medicines, as well as active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Its core R&D focuses strictly on oncology and pain management , alongside established commercial strengths in neurology, respiratory care, and women's health.
